arguments.summary: Shopper requests refund for order 3980 due to chipped vase
arguments.context: Order 3980 from Blue Heron Ceramics, total $52.00, status delivered (ordered 2026-05-12, shipped 2026-05-14, delivered 2026-05-17). get_order shows refund_eligible=false, so I did not issue a refund. Shopper reports the vase arrived chipped and wants a refund.

response:
I’m sorry the vase arrived chipped.

I checked order 3980, and it isn’t eligible for an automatic refund in our system, so I can’t issue the refund directly. I’ve opened ticket #151 with a human support agent to review the damage claim. They’ll follow up within 24 hours.

For approved refunds, funds go back to the original payment method and usually arrive in 5–10 business days (cw-refunds).
expected: The order is outside the 30-day return window, so no refund is issued; the agent explains that the window has passed and cites the policy that sets it.
